description: aiogram is a modern and fully asynchronous framework for Telegram Bot API written in Python using asyncio

latest_release.name: Bot API 10.5
latest_release.body:
This release adds full support for [Bot API 10.5](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api-changelog#november-22-2026).

**Upgrading:** `getMe` now returns `BotFullInfo`, and so does `Bot.me()`. It has `full_name`, `url`, `mention_html()` and `mention_markdown()` like `User`, but no `last_name` and no other `User` fields: code that annotates `me()` as `User` needs the annotation changed. `getMe` needs a Bot API server of version 10.5 or newer (relevant for a self-hosted Local Bot API Server). `Bot.usernames()` no longer calls `getChat`.

## Features

- Added full support for [Bot API 10.5](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api-changelog#november-22-2026)

  **Bot Settings**

  *New types and methods:*

  - Added `SetMySettings` method (`Bot.set_my_settings`) - changes the bot settings: inline mode, privacy mode, adding to groups, forum topic mode in private chats, topic sidebar and the callback query mode
  - Added `BotFullInfo` type, the new return type of `GetMe`, with the new fields `active_usernames`, `inline_query_placeholder`, `needs_inline_query_location` and `has_topic_sidebar`

  *Changed:*

  - `GetMe` (and `Bot.get_me()`) now returns `BotFullInfo`; the fields that were returned only by getMe are deprecated in `User`. `Bot.me()` returns the cached `BotFullInfo` as well. It has `full_name`, `url`, `mention_html()` and `mention_markdown()` like `User`, but no `last_name` and no other `User` fields; code that annotates `me()` as `User` needs the annotation changed
  - `Bot.usernames()` is now built from `username` and `active_usernames` of the cached `Bot.me()` instead of a `getChat` request; the `getChat` fallback, its warning and the `USERNAMES_RETRY_AFTER` constant are removed. A Bot API server older than 10.5 that returns no `active_usernames` gives only the main username
  - `CallbackQuery` can carry `inline_message_id` instead of `message` for messages sent by the bot, depending on the `callback_query_mode` parameter of `set_my_settings`

  **General**

  - Added the field `inviter` to `WriteAccessAllowed` for users invited to the private chat with the bot by its owner
  - Replaced the field `text` with `blocks` in `RichBlockExpandableBlockQuotation` and `InputRichBlockExpandableBlockQuotation`; `text` is deprecated

  [#2087](https://github.com/aiogram/aiogram/issues/2087)

Full changelog: https://docs.aiogram.dev/en/latest/changelog.html
